|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Ommni Box & It's Worse (V)]]. The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. It is the current text. * '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-b65c961">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/ommniboxitsworse.gif</code> as published 2 December 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b65c961784833ee85707666198a3d8bd794c032c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/ommniboxitsworse.gif holotable commit b65c961] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “USED: For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): A Good Blaster At Your Side, No Disintegrations!, Stardust, and They Will Be Lost And Confused. OR Cancel Blast The Door, Kid! or It Could Be Worse. (Immune to It's A Hit!) OR Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.”
The Original card face was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025).
